fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck yard is enclosed by black metal perimeter fencing with a sliding gate at the truck-court entrance (clearly visible in Street View 2026-02 at the NW truck-court driveway).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard-booth structure visible at the gated truck entrance in satellite or Street View - the gate appears remotely controlled.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true - there is a controlled fenced/gated truck entry but no guard booth, implying kiosk/app/remote check-in. Medium confidence; flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large cross-dock warehouse (~375 m long) with continuous dock-door banks and trailers backed in on BOTH the west and east long faces - 50+ band (730,000 sq ft per Racklify; legacy DSC Logistics site).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two physically separate building faces (east and west).
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer drop yards run along both the west and east truck courts with 120+ parked trailers in rows; an additional trailer overflow lot sits SE of the building - dropArea 50+ band.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Set false - the truck courts are moderately sized and bounded by streets/fence with limited spare apron width for a dedicated express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the dense Perris CA industrial fabric - a contiguous cluster of large distribution warehouses; Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single gated truck-court entry; lane split not resolvable from imagery.
